note: SAMPLE. Synthetic Oldham residents for the demo. No real people or real data.

personas.label: Family: council tax arrears, low pay, son of 17 out of college (English)
personas.notes: Mum in her late 30s, came in with a council tax reminder letter. About three months behind, it says she owes around 640 pounds and must pay within 7 days. Works part-time as a care assistant, around 16 hours a week on minimum wage, gets some Universal Credit. Three children: two at primary school, and her eldest son is 17. He left college at Christmas and has not been in work or training since. He stays in his room a lot. She thinks he would like to do something practical, maybe with cars or building. She is not sure the younger two get free school meals and has never claimed anything for childcare. Says she is always behind on something and does not know where to start.

personas.label: Dad off work with a back injury, Universal Credit cut (speaks Bengali)
personas.notes: Man in his 40s, speaks Bengali and a little English, his daughter helped translate. Worked in a warehouse for eight years, off sick since a back injury four months ago and the job has now ended. Universal Credit was reduced last month and he does not understand why, there is a letter he could not read. Wife does not work, three children. Wants to work again but cannot do heavy lifting or long shifts on his feet. Has a smartphone but little data and no laptop. Says he feels ashamed asking for help.

personas.label: 19, sofa surfing, told to leave tonight (English)
personas.notes: Young man, 19. Has been sleeping on a friend's sofa for a month and was told this morning he has to go, so he has nowhere to sleep tonight. Has not eaten since yesterday. Left college last year without finishing his course. Not claiming any benefits. Phone is working but low on credit.
